text: Doing lat pulldowns for months... but your back still isn't getting wider?
A wide grip feels great in your upper back, but your elbows can't travel very far.
A close grip lets you pull deeper, through a longer range, with a little help from your biceps.
Truth is, both build your lats. Studies show only small differences between grips.
Pick the grip you can pull to your chest with control, and switch it every few weeks. Save this.
